label: Native map $BFE3

collision.meaning: Native fixed Solid becomes four Forge Solid cells; native Empty becomes four Forge Empty cells.

adaptation.graphics: reset palette and source metatile tiles; random and later visual transformations omitted

evidence.claim: Linked configuration bounds, pointer copy, dispatch handlers, zero-filled native map buffer and referenced full-solid predicate identify this command representation.
Reset vector, linked PB53 unpacker and fixed-size uploader establish the exact native graphics construction without executing input code.
Map-linked renderer and attribute helper establish visible metatile quadrants and palette indices before PrettyLevel.

The selected raw static map, decoded metatile graphics and native full-solid cell meaning become a canonical Forge scene. The separate generated project uses authored test-player assets and Forge physics.

limitations: Static command-map geometry before native decoration only. Random maps, clouds, grass/platform decoration, scrolling, wrapping, cycling blocks, hazards, one-way platforms, actors, audio and original game logic are not reconstructed.

Only declared native Empty and fixed Solid cells convert. Unknown or unsupported collision never defaults to Empty. The visible 16 × 15 metatile region maps exactly to 32 × 30 Forge tiles; a nonempty hidden native row prevents conversion.

Import appends an excluded editable scene through one Undo transaction. Download map project creates a separate Forge single-room adaptation with an authored test player and default Forge movement; it does not recreate native physics or gameplay.
Graphics use the proven reset palette and raw command-map metatiles, before PrettyLevel decoration and later palette updates. Source sprites, clipping and later runtime writes are not reproduced.

Uniform tile collision uses existing tile properties. Ambiguous reuse uses linked metatile overrides. Raw visual edits can detach links and fall back to tile properties under the existing editor rules.
The original ROM is unchanged. This method does not supply a native encoder, ROM patch or whole-game reconstruction.

Static command-map rendering uses the original metatile tile and palette-index tables before PrettyLevel. Random clouds, grass/platform substitutions, gameplay actors and later visual changes are omitted.
The recovered palette is the reset upload, including native universal-color aliases and the explicit slot-seven write. Level-specific background changes and animated sprite colors are not recovered.
PB53 is interpreted with this verified loader's 128-byte persistent buffer. Tile control $83 copies its existing buffer slot; it does not mean a previous 4 KiB bank in this loader configuration.
Unknown initial decompression-buffer bytes remain marked unknown; a static map using such a tile cannot be converted. Native row fifteen is data outside the visible 16 by 15 metatile screen.
The source resets with rendering disabled. Its final reset control selects the recovered background bank; the editor viewer supplies its own rendering state.
